senses.gloss: m. (שָׁתָה I; cmp. b. h. שְׁתִי) [drinkableness,] body of wine, strength.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 11:1:3">Y. Ter. XI, 47ᶜ</cite>, sq. (expl. <he>ממעיטו</he>, Mish.

<cite ref="Mishnah Terumot 11:1">Ter. XI, 1</cite>) <he>ממעטהו משׁוֹתְיוֹ</he> he lessens its body (by boiling), contrad. to <he>ממידתו</he> its quantity; ib. II, end, 41ᵈ; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:7:9">Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41ᶜ</cite> top.
